text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning!
Are you out for morning practice too, C.B.-san?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
......Huh!?
I-I'd never stand a chance against them!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. You won't know until you try.
After all, you love running, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
She loves it... or rather,
maybe she just can't help but run.
Watching her lately, that's what I've been thinking.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: W-Why would you say something like that...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Only when you're running
are you breathing purely for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I understand.
Because on the turf, you are freer than anywhere else.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I-I look forward to working with you!
